pages.text: Converts total stress of the bound network into a shield that absorbs damage. When the shield breaks, it deals small-area knockback damage. If no damage is taken for 5 seconds, the shield gradually recovers 20% of its max capacity per second. Every 5000 points of stress grants 1 shield point. Right-click a Stress Reader to bind; sneak plus right-click to unbind. If a Stress Ark exists, manual binding is not required. The more stress, the safer you are.
